title.narrative: Support for the The Presidency of the Council of Ministers of Peru forthe Creation of the National Infrastructure Authority (ANIN)

description.narrative: The Presidency of the Council of Ministers of Peru (PCM) has requested the assistance of the UNOPS for the implementation of a newly created government entity: the “National Infrastructure Authority (ANIN)”. UNOPS will provide said technical assistance to the PCM to create the institutional conditions as well as the implementation of the ANIN, guiding actions towards excellence in the public management of infrastructure investment.
